runtime.scope: process runtime/file-progress budget, not proof of algorithm deadlock or hardware acceptance

physical_memory_reconciliation.scope: post-PNR storage accounting only; routing failure and timing acceptance remain separate

global_assignments.scope: actual flat-netlist direct loads and reported global assignment; not route status, congestion or identification of unrouted nets

high_fanout_direct_loads.scope: direct input-pin references only; excludes clocks/constants, does not resolve assign aliases or identify unrouted nets

physical_routing_request_checks.scope: reported global assignment only; individual BUFG index and route delays require separate evidence

lidar_physical_connectivity.scope: four explicit synchronizer groups only; not full CDC, reset, IO, MTBF or physical skew signoff

host_physical_connectivity.scope: host FIFO Gray and frame-toggle connections only; vendor PCS, status, IO/reset and MTBF remain separate

next_single_factor.scope: only request observation update BUFG CE|LOGIC plus projection CE LOCAL; keep original12 targets, four real clocks and all source/SDC/CSR bytes
